verdict.rationale: Cake offers an MCP server allowing AI assistants like Claude/Cursor/Codex to query live cap table data (shareholders, option pools, vesting, SAFEs) in plain English, which supports programmatic cap table pulls. However, there's no evidence of reconciliation against an external data room, no documented API/OpenAPI spec for structured programmatic access (openapi probe returned 404s), and no mention of data-room integration or comparison workflows. missing for 10: documented API/OpenAPI for structured data pulls, data room integration or reconciliation feature, evidence of comparing cap table against external documents.
